name: Yomo Mitsuru
source:
Mitsuru is the Student Council Vice President. She is known around the school as a "prince" because of her demeanor. Mitsuru and [url=/c98214]Reika[/url] have been friends since they were children.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
